name: Outer Realms Corrupter
description: A shifting, formless mass seemingly made of chromatic light.

abilities.name: Will-Shattering Touch
abilities.description: When a PC takes damage from the Corrupter, they lose a Hope.

abilities.name: Disgorge Reality Flotsam
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to spew partially digested portions of consumed realities at all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or mark 2 Stress.
